about: The exception that each client library raises for the error pages in content/develop/reference/errors/common/, and what its message looks like. Keyed by page file name. Both clients were run against a live server, with the same scenarios as build/errors/live_checks.py: redis-py as recorded in build/errors/live_baseline.json, and Jedis on redis:8.10 (server 8.10.2) with the version below.

redis-py.message: <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
redis-py.note: `RedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

jedis.message: ASK <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
jedis.note: `JedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

redis-py.message: BUSY Redis is busy running a script. You can only call SCRIPT KILL or SHUTDOWN NOSAVE.

jedis.message: BUSY Redis is busy running a script. You can only call SCRIPT KILL or SHUTDOWN NOSAVE.

redis-py.message: BUSYGROUP Consumer Group name already exists

jedis.message: BUSYGROUP Consumer Group name already exists

redis-py.message: BUSYKEY Target key name already exists.

jedis.message: BUSYKEY Target key name already exists.

redis-py.message: The cluster is down

jedis.message: CLUSTERDOWN The cluster is down

redis-py.message: Keys in request don't hash to the same slot

jedis.message: CROSSSLOT Keys in request don't hash to the same slot

redis-py.message: Connection closed by server.

jedis.message: Unexpected end of stream.

redis-py.message: max number of clients reached

jedis.message: Unexpected end of stream.

redis-py.message: value is not an integer or out of range

jedis.message: ERR value is not an integer or out of range

redis-py.message: syntax error

jedis.message: ERR syntax error

redis-py.message: unknown command '<command>', with args beginning with: <args>

jedis.message: ERR unknown command '<command>', with args beginning with: <args>

redis-py.message: wrong number of arguments for '<command>' command

jedis.message: ERR wrong number of arguments for '<command>' command

redis-py.message: Command # <n> (<command>) of pipeline caused error: <error>
redis-py.note: redis-py raises the error of the command that failed to queue, not `EXECABORT`.

jedis.message: EXECABORT Transaction discarded because of previous errors.
jedis.note: The errors of the commands that failed to queue are attached to the exception as suppressed exceptions.

redis-py.message: Redis is loading the dataset in memory

jedis.message: LOADING Redis is loading the dataset in memory

redis-py.message: Link with MASTER is down and replica-serve-stale-data is set to 'no'.

jedis.message: MASTERDOWN Link with MASTER is down and replica-serve-stale-data is set to 'no'.

redis-py.message: MISCONF Redis is configured to save RDB snapshots, but it's currently unable to persist to disk. Commands that may modify the data set are disabled, because this instance is configured to report errors during writes if RDB snapshotting fails (stop-writes-on-bgsave-error option). Please check the Redis logs for details about the RDB error.

jedis.message: MISCONF Redis is configured to save RDB snapshots, but it's currently unable to persist to disk. Commands that may modify the data set are disabled, because this instance is configured to report errors during writes if RDB snapshotting fails (stop-writes-on-bgsave-error option). Please check the Redis logs for details about the RDB error.

redis-py.note: `RedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

jedis.message: MOVED <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
jedis.note: `JedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

redis-py.message: Authentication required.

jedis.message: NOAUTH Authentication required.

redis-py.message: NOGROUP No such key '<key>' or consumer group '<group>' in XREADGROUP with GROUP option

jedis.message: NOGROUP No such key '<key>' or consumer group '<group>' in XREADGROUP with GROUP option

redis-py.message: User <username> has no permissions to run the '<command>' command

jedis.message: NOREPLICAS Not enough good replicas to write.

jedis.message: NOSCRIPT No matching script. Please use EVAL.

redis-py.message: You can't write against a read only replica.

jedis.message: READONLY You can't write against a read only replica.

jedis.message: TRYAGAIN Multiple keys request during rehashing of slot

redis-py.message: invalid username-password pair or user is disabled.

jedis.note: `AUTH` with a password for a user that has none returns `ERR AUTH <password> called without any password configured for the default user…`, which is a `JedisDataException`.
